runtime_table_reference_inventory.method: Python AST string constants containing exact table identifier tokens. Locations are lexical dependencies, not proof of SQL execution; partial f-string fragments and schema-name metadata are included. Validate caller behavior against source. No raw business rows.

reply_attempt_direct_column_consumers.method: AST explicit attribute reads on named attempt variables and keyword calls to existing persistence/finalization APIs; a bounded navigation map, not whole-program dataflow or proof of absence. Whole-row SELECT/model/API consumers are described separately in the map.

reply_attempt_column_groups.source_behavior: Primary integer attempt identity and channel/conversation/trigger association. Latest, queue, sent-delivery and human-decision readers use these scalar fields. ID allocates via AUTOINCREMENT; no logical trigger uniqueness constraint.
Active input text; settled input compaction clears text and retains SHA-256/byte count/task ID/matching input ID provenance. Current model/UI consumes both; the provenance is not the body.

Business action/type, reason and result summary. Worker delivery/OA summary, daily report, History and human-visible failure explanations consume them. audit_summary is not a persisted tool trajectory.

reply_attempt_column_groups.purpose: Reply drafts, final text and decisions
reply_attempt_column_groups.source_behavior: Draft/final business reply, decision display and stored human options. Writes include record, update, orchestrated finalization and reviewed-rerun paths.

Logical relation to a run and native transcript slice. No declared reply_attempts.agent_run_id FK in either captured source. History/status reconciliation uses typed runs/tasks plus this link; native details are read through session and line bounds.
Stored reference collection, separate from audit summary and native tool event detail.

reply_attempt_column_groups.purpose: Tool-event placeholder and reviewed marker exception
reply_attempt_column_groups.source_behavior: Normal persistence/finalization converts event arrays to []; in-process events still feed Memory-event extraction. Reviewed rerun directly appends/inserts audit_review queued marker and bypasses the converter. History has a legacy stored-event fallback after native lookup.
Recipient metadata used by direct delivery/attempt presentation. Defaults are empty strings; both are current model fields.
OA identity, requested action/remark and durable action result. OA-specific history/current-error resolution and worker rendering consume these facts.
Calendar identity, response and business receipt. History classifies calendar action by these fields.
Mail identity, subject/reply and result receipt. Current model/API exposes these business facts.
Business result payloads, distinct from tool-event trajectories. Writer allowlist and finalization support both.
Attempt status/error/retry state. Task/run/delivery joins can project current display status separately from raw attempt status; raw values remain inputs to existing reconciliation and queue logic.

Review timestamp, corrective text, feedback scope and skill-update request/receipts. Reviewed-rerun may update an existing attempt in place while changing the task generation; source behavior must be captured, not inferred solely from generic lifecycle prose.
Current resolution, ordering, age, latest-attempt and history facts. Several SQL paths intentionally distinguish raw status from resolved rows.

Nonempty historical data remains present.
